name: std::iswlower
intro:
Checks if the given wide character is a lowercase letter, i.e. one of abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz or any lowercase letter specific to the current locale.

If the value of ch is neither representable as a wchar_t nor equal to the value of the macro WEOF, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Non-zero value if the wide character is a lowercase letter, zero otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: ISO 30112 specifies which Unicode characters are include in POSIX lower category.

examples.output:
in the default locale, iswlower(0x444) = false
in Unicode locale, iswlower(0x444) = true
